prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one white-background empty-state illustration for an education app. The first reference image is the approved CANONICAL CHARACTER AND STYLE. Preserve the same sky-blue scalloped cloud model, broad silhouette, large top lobe, side and bottom lobes, exact body aspect ratio, dark oval eye shape and size, interocular distance, eye highlight shape, cheek size/placement, mouth position, round mitten hands and arm thickness. No separate head, feet, legs or tail. Expression and arm pose may change but do not redesign the model. Crisp 2D cartoon sticker style with uniformly bold rounded #252436 ink outlines, predominantly flat solid colors, sky-blue body #91c9ff, pink cheeks #ffa9c3, butter yellow #ffe078, mint #9ce2bf, lavender #c2adff, ivory #fffdf7. Small hard offset dark shadow attached to lower-right edges of character and props. No airbrush, 3D, realistic material, grain, soft shadow, gradients, white sticker halo, border, text, symbols, logo or interface. Pure white #FFFFFF square canvas. One complete centered character, generous white margins, front-facing model consistent across a set of four. Cloud body approximately 65% of canvas width, character/props fit within central 78% of canvas, no cropped parts. IMPORTANT: below the whole character, separated by a small white gap, include ONE narrow horizontal pale cyan-blue FLAT OVAL ground shadow, width about half the cloud body, height about 4% of its width. This ellipse suggests gentle floating. It has no outline, blur or gradient. Reference image 2 is ONLY a reference for this detached small cyan ellipse under a floating character; do NOT borrow its character, colors or face. Keep the elliptical shadow clear of character silhouette. Scene 1, NO COURSES: cloud holds an open butter-yellow textbook with ivory pages and a mint ribbon bookmark at its lower front, one mitten holding the book and the other raised in a small welcoming wave. Face looks directly at viewer with relaxed brows and gentle happy open smile. Two small yellow outlined greeting rays near raised hand. Same canonical model and face; no other props. The floating ellipse is centered underneath the lowest point of the book.
